notes: Standard LTS420 (non-E) with T96-S controller and LNP96-S LN2 pump. Geometry: a flat 166 x 90 x 24 mm stage body (Linkam spec page; McCrone lists an older '160 x 80 x 24 mm') carrying a 53.5 x 43 mm silver block; swing-out lid with a standard 18 mm viewing aperture (Bioimager, Linkam distributor; 35/50 mm on request); inner lid for stability. Window count 2 = top lid window plus a lower window inferred only from 'Can be used with transmitted or reflected light' and the published condenser working distance of 12.5 mm; the lower aperture size is not published. Stage body is water-cooled for work above 300 C (brochure). Objective min working distance 6.5 mm, condenser 12.5 mm. Temperature < -195 C (78 K) to 420 C, stability < 0.01 C, rates 0.01-50 C/min. LN2 is pumped from the LNP96 dewar by the control unit's pumps (T96-controlled) and injected directly into the block; the T96 drives the Pt100 sensor and heater. No electrical sample lines in this configuration (LTS420E variants add 2-pin LEMO/BNC/probes). Brochure quotes come from Linkam's own 'Download PDF Product Brochure' link on https://www.linkam.co.uk/lts420-brochure (Google Drive id 1wbj1pLk89eX-y2dWxbxm_mYzIBILZAab, v1.18 2026); v5_snapshot could not cache it (robots.txt), text extracted locally.
